title: Aromatic Garlic Butter Rice
description: Fragrant toasted rice tossed with golden sauteed garlic and rich melted butter.
steps: Mince 4 cloves of garlic and finely dice half an onion.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Saute the garlic and onion until golden and fragrant (about 3 minutes).
Add 2 cups of cooked rice to the pan and toss evenly with the butter sauce.
Season with salt and peeper to taste, and serve hot.

title: Homestyle Spiced Egg Bhurji
description: Soft scrambled eggs gently spiced and sauteed with caramelized onions and pungent mustard oil.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of mustard oil in pan until lightly smoking, then reduce to medium.
Add finely chopped onions and minced garlic. Saute until golden brown (about 4 minutes).
Crack 3 eggs into a bowl, whisk lightly with a pinch of salt.
Pour whisked eggs into pan and stir continuously for 2-3 minutes until soft curds form.
Remove from heat immediately to keep eggs tender. Serve with warm bread or rice.

title: Classic Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: A timeless Italian staple: al dente pasta coated in garlic-infused olive oil with gentle chili heat.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook pasta until al dente (about 8-10 minutes).
While pasta cooks, thinly slice 5 cloves of garlic.
Heat 1/4 cup of olive oil in a wide pan over low-medium heat. Add garlic and sizzle gently until pale golden (about 3 minutes).
Transfer cooked pasta directly into the garlic oil along with 2 tablespoons of pasta water.
Toss vigorously for 1 minute until an emulsified glossy sauce coats every strand.

title: Pantry Egg Fried Rice
description: High-heat skillet fried rice with scrambled eggs, caramelized aromatics, and savory depth.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or heavy skillet over high heat.
Crack in 2 eggs and scramble quickly for 45 seconds, then set eggs aside on a plate.
Add another splash of oil, toss in minced garlic and onions. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add chilled cooked rice, breaking up clumps with a spatula.
Fold the scrambled eggs back in, season with salt and pepper, and stir-fry for 2 more minutes.

title: Silky French Omelette
description: Velvety, pale-gold rolled omelette with a soft, custard-like center.
steps: Beat 3 eggs vigorously with a pinch of salt until completely smooth with no streaks.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in an 8-inch non-stick skillet over medium-low heat without browning.
Pour eggs in and shake the pan continuously in small circular motions while stirring with a fork.
When the eggs are nearly set but still moist on top, gently roll into a cylinder.
Slide onto a plate seam-side down and rub the top with a silver of cold butter for shine.

title: Golden Caramelized Onion Pasta
description: Sweet, deeply browned onions melted down with garlic butter toasted with al dente pasta.
steps: Thinly slice 2 large onions.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a pan over low heat, add onions and cook slowly for 12-15 minutes until sweet and deep golden.
Cook pasta in salted boiling water until tender.
Stir 2 minced garlic cloves into the caramelized onions for the final minute.
Combine pasta with the onion sauce and a splash of cooking water.
